copy.hero_sub: On-site in 45 minutes across East Cobb and Marietta. Flat-rate quotes on the phone before we touch anything. MP207455 on every invoice since 1993.
copy.services_lead: Joey or his son Caleb does the work. Nobody else. Here's what we handle, and what you'll pay.

services.title: Main Line Drain Clearing
services.body: Camera-jet diagnostics with the video recording emailed to you same day. Most Marietta main lines cleared in under 2 hours.

services.title: Slab Leak Repair
services.body: Electronic leak detection — no jackhammer guesswork. Diagnosed and quoted before a single floor tile moves.

services.title: Water Heater Install
services.body: Rheem or Bradford White, pulled-permit install. If your existing unit has life left, Joey will tell you straight.

services.title: Hydro-Jetting
services.body: 4,000 PSI jetting for grease-packed or root-invaded lines in East Cobb, Sandy Springs, and Smyrna.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.body: Evenings, Saturdays, and Sunday emergencies. Joey came out at 11pm on a Saturday — that's not a tagline, it's a review.

what_we_dont_do: We don't send apprentices. Joey or Caleb. That's the whole crew.
We don't quote jobs we can't diagnose. If we need to see it first, we say so.
We don't add charges after we've quoted you. The number on the phone is the number on the invoice.
copy.guarantee: Price we quote on the phone is the price on the invoice — or you don't pay the difference.

reviews_list.author: Margaret W.
reviews_list.text: Joey himself came out Saturday at 11pm when my main line backed up. Quoted me before he started, no surprise charges. Camera-jetted the line and emailed me the recording. Done in 90 minutes.

reviews_list.author: David T.
reviews_list.text: Third plumber I called after two no-shows. Peach State picked up on the first ring, was at my house in 45 min, and the price he quoted on the phone is the price I paid. License # right on the truck.

reviews_list.author: Sarah K.
reviews_list.text: 32 years of doing this shows. Joey diagnosed a slab leak in 10 minutes that another company quoted me $4,500 to find. His repair: $1,890 flat.

reviews_list.author: Robert H.
reviews_list.text: Does not upsell. Told me my water heater had another 2-3 years if I flushed it; could have sold me a new one easy.

copy.footer_blurb: Joey Calloway has been under Cobb County sinks and slabs since 1993 — the same guy answering the phone is the guy showing up with the truck.

top_strengths: Bebas Neue display + Inter body is a confident, trade-appropriate type pair that immediately reads premium over competitors
Owner-voice specificity is dialed: named crew (Joey/Caleb), flat prices on every service tile, dated reviews, license # in footer and hero — all 7 agency tells hit
'What we don't do' callout + guarantee block + by-the-numbers stats break the rectangle and signal intentional hierarchy beyond a template
top_weaknesses: Bold-list services section risks reading flat without a visual differentiator (icon treatment or alternating layout) to complement the strong copy
Gallery/by-the-numbers section is data-only — no photo grading signal visible in the fingerprint, leaving palette cohesion unconfirmed across imagery
Rugged-shop-orange palette commitment can't be fully verified without seeing accent/neutral tension; if orange is the only color doing work, sections may blur together
awwwards.one_line_verdict: Looks like $5K agency work — Bebas + orange palette + brutal price specificity + Joey's name everywhere makes every plumber comp look like a template.
